poc-M-01.t.sol.vuln_summary: Confirms rewardBudget remains stranded (86400000000000000 wei == RATE * 1 day tail) after schedule expiry with zero dispatcher inflow. Assertions prove (a) rewardBudget > 0 post-expiry, (b) currentRewardRate() == 0, (c) stake/unstake/claim/pullAndRefresh all fail to reset the schedule, (d) owner topUp(1) is the only recovery path.

poc-M-02.t.sol.vuln_summary: Confirms emergencyWithdraw leaves 50000000000000 wei phUSD (Alice's forfeited half-share of 100s * RATE slice) permanently stranded in the contract. Invariant broken: balance (50000000000000) > rewardBudget (0) after schedule depletes and all remaining stakers exit. topUp cannot recover (it adds, never sweeps), no owner-rescue selector exists.
